messages:
ana: Morning — need to lock a 45m slot this week for an inference perf readout and optimisation sync. Goal: pick changes to promote to canary (quant, batch, kernel tweaks). Prefer Wed/Thu. Agenda draft: 1) benchmark baseline (latency/cost by model + seq len) 2) quant/precision experiments 3) KV cache & batching changes 4) action items. Who's in? Available windows: Wed 11:00-11:45 PT, Wed 16:00-16:45 PT, Thu 09:00-09:45 PT. Please add availability.

 dmitri: Wed 11 works for me. Add 'dashboard walkthrough' under baseline. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/infer-perf — will drop a short pre-read.

 mei: I can do Thu morning only. If we go Wed maybe record? else Thu 09 works. +1 on dashboard walkthrough.

 ryan: Can we push to 60m? The quant discussion needs time. Otherwise I'll be tight to get kernel tuning results ready.

 ana: prefer 45 to avoid calendar churn, but fine to extend to 60 if majority ok. vote? :hand:

 julie: I vote 60 — need time to review canary failure modes. Also can someone post the perf-run command/flags we used last night?

 dmitri: paste: ```
./run_bench --model=gpt-nano --seq=1024 --dynamic-batch --quant=bits8 --kernels=auto
```

 perf-bot: nightly-run: 1931170000 summary attached — median p95=98ms, cost/token=$0.0034 for gpt-nano @seq512. See /artifacts/1931170000

 ana: ok looks like Thu 09:00 PT wins (mei + julie + ana + dmitri), but ryan prefers Wed. Mei can you confirm Thu for speakers? I'll book and add pre-read (bench csv + slides).

 mei: confirmed. I'll own benchmark baseline slides. Will upload by Wed EOD.

 ryan: I can prep a 10min section on kernel/compilation tradeoffs and a demo of failing regression.

 ana: great. Action items: mei — slides + baseline csv; dmitri — dashboard live link + run config; ryan — kernel demo; julie — failure modes checklist. I'll send calendar invite with recording enabled. cc: @eng-platform for recording retention policy.

 ana: booking sent — calendar invite created for Thu 09:00 PT, 60m. Invite includes link to dashboard and pre-reads. Recording on.
